contract: Opt-in profiling is gated by KRASIS_EXPERT_HQQ_TRACE_COMPARE_PROFILE and only reports offline comparator phase timing.
Comparator reads the existing full trace through BufReader plus serde_json::from_reader; comparison semantics and fail-closed parsing are unchanged.

Comparator groups the same full-buffer trace stages and compares independent blocks in parallel inside each request using rayon; every block still uses the existing CPU oracle and exact/full-buffer contracts.
Activation may pass with nonzero deltas only when mismatch details prove actual BF16 zero versus positive BF16 subnormal references; normal activation deltas and reverse/negative cases still fail.
No runtime launch path, production HQQ output path, fallback behavior, decode/HCS path, selected-expert retargeting, or speed benchmark path changed.
